title: Prepare Cloud Batch jobs before template rendering
body:
Airflow replaces Jinja templates after an operator is created. Previously, this
operator converted protobuf jobs into dictionaries while it was being created,
which was too early.

The conversion is still needed because Airflow can only find and replace
templates inside nested job fields after the job becomes a dictionary.

This change moves the conversion to `prepare_template()`. The operator now
keeps the original job during construction and converts it immediately before
Airflow processes its templates. It also removes the operator from the
`validate-operators-init` exemption list.

Testing:

- 15 focused Google provider tests passed.
- All applicable prek hooks passed.
- A real Google Cloud Batch operator smoke test succeeded and Cloud Logging
  confirmed the rendered nested command; test resources were deleted.

Related: #70296
